Agent.description: A turn's agent acting for no one. It holds nothing, and can't be granted a role.
Agent.title: Agent

AuditEntry.description: An event in the audit log, with its place in it.
AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry

Check.description: One question for ``/checks``: may the caller take this action on this resource?
Check.title: Check

Grant.description: A role, on a resource, to a grantee: in a tenant, or on the deployment.
Grant.title: Grant

GrantRequest.description: A role, on a resource, to a grantee: to grant, or to revoke.
GrantRequest.title: GrantRequest

Group.description: A tenant's named set of users and service principals, granted roles like a subject.
Group.title: Group

GroupDefined.description: A group was created, or its members replaced.
GroupDefined.title: GroupDefined

GroupDeleted.description: A group was deleted, with its grants.
GroupDeleted.title: GroupDeleted

IssuedKey.description: A key, shown once, and the audit entry that records it.
IssuedKey.title: IssuedKey

KeyIssued.description: A key was issued to a service principal.
KeyIssued.title: KeyIssued

KeyView.description: A key as listed: its public id and its principal.
KeyView.title: KeyView

Me.description: The caller in one tenant: their roles on it, and the workspaces they can open.
Me.title: Me

MemberAdded.description: A user or service principal joined the tenant.
MemberAdded.title: MemberAdded

MemberRemoved.description: A member left the tenant, with its grants, its places in groups, and its keys.
MemberRemoved.title: MemberRemoved

Membership.description: A user's place in a tenant: the roles granted to them on it.
Membership.title: Membership

Memberships.description: Every tenant the caller is a member of, when they name none.
Memberships.title: Memberships

NewKey.description: The service principal a key is issued to.
NewKey.title: NewKey

NewMember.description: A user or service principal to add to a tenant.
NewMember.title: NewMember

NewTenant.description: A tenant to create, with its first owner.
NewTenant.title: NewTenant

Resource.description: A resource, by its kind, its workspace if it is in one, and its id if it is an item.
Resource.title: Resource

Restricted.description: A thread or artifact was restricted to those granted a role on it.
Restricted.title: Restricted

Restriction.description: A thread or artifact, and whether it is restricted to those granted a role on it.
Restriction.title: Restriction

Role.description: A tenant's own role: a named set of the actions a workspace's admin holds.
Role.title: Role

RoleDefined.description: A custom role was created, or its actions replaced.
RoleDefined.title: RoleDefined

RoleDeleted.description: A custom role was deleted, with its grants.
RoleDeleted.title: RoleDeleted

RulePrincipal.description: A reflexr rule, named by its workspace and rule: its runs act as it.
RulePrincipal.title: RulePrincipal

ServicePrincipal.description: A tenant's non-human principal: an integration, an MCP client or the application.
ServicePrincipal.title: ServicePrincipal

TenantCreated.description: A tenant was created, with its first owner.
TenantCreated.title: TenantCreated

TenantDeleted.description: A tenant was deleted, with everything grantr held for it but its audit log.
TenantDeleted.title: TenantDeleted

Unrestricted.description: A thread or artifact's restriction was lifted: its workspace's roles hold on it again.
Unrestricted.title: Unrestricted

User.description: A person, by their identity provider's id.
User.title: User

get.description: The deployment's audit log: its operators, granted and revoked.

schema.title: Response Deployment Audit Grantr V1 Audit Get

post.description:
Answer a batch of up to 100 checks for the caller, in order.

Each command is checked again when it arrives.

schema.title: Response Checks Grantr V1 Checks Post

get.description:
The caller in the tenant ``X-Tenant`` names, or every tenant they are a member of.

In a tenant: the caller's roles on it, and the workspaces they can open.

schema.title: Response Me Grantr V1 Me Get

delete.description: Stop a user being an operator.

put.description: Make a user an operator of the deployment.

schema.title: Response List Tenants Grantr V1 Tenants Get

post.description: Create a tenant, with its first owner.

delete.description: Delete a tenant, and everything grantr holds for it but its audit log.

get.description: A tenant's audit log after ``after_seq``, in order.

schema.title: Response Tenant Audit Grantr V1 Tenants  Tenant  Audit Get

get.description: Every grant in a tenant, or on a workspace and the items in it.

schema.title: Response List Grants Grantr V1 Tenants  Tenant  Grants Get

post.description: Grant a role on a resource.

get.description: A tenant's groups, by id, with their members.

schema.title: Response List Groups Grantr V1 Tenants  Tenant  Groups Get

delete.description: Delete a group, with its grants.

put.description: Create a group, or replace its members.

get.description: A tenant's keys: their ids and principals, never their secrets.

schema.title: Response List Keys Grantr V1 Tenants  Tenant  Keys Get

post.description: Issue a key for a service principal. The key is in this response, and nowhere else.

schema.title: Response List Members Grantr V1 Tenants  Tenant  Members Get

post.description: Add a user or service principal to a tenant.

delete.description: Remove a member, with its grants, its places in groups and its keys.

get.description: The threads and artifacts restricted in a workspace.

schema.title: Response List Restrictions Grantr V1 Tenants  Tenant  Restrictions Get

post.description: Restrict a thread or artifact, or lift its restriction.

schema.title: Response List Roles Grantr V1 Tenants  Tenant  Roles Get

delete.description: Delete a custom role, with its grants.

put.description: Create a custom role, or replace its actions.
